# RAIM SMILE — Bishkek partner pipeline

Status: research-backed target list / outreach not implied.

## Priority A

### Crocus Fitness Bishkek
Model: premium club affinity partnership.
Proposed product: `RAIM SMILE Club Dental Privilege`.
Why first: repeated member contact, premium/wellness context, family potential.
Ask: member-app/email/front-desk distribution, event/content access, trackable member eligibility.
Check before pitch: current dental exclusivity and actual membership communication surfaces.

### AmCham Kyrgyz Republic
Model: business-community / member benefit.
Proposed product: `RAIM SMILE Executive Dental Privilege`.
Why: one relationship can expose RAIM SMILE to many companies and decision-makers.
Ask: member-benefit listing, newsletter/event access, introductions to interested member companies.

### BAKAI Premium Banking
Model: private banking / card privilege.
Proposed product: `RAIM SMILE Private Dental Privilege`.
Why: existing premium-benefit logic makes the proposition easy to understand.
Ask: privileges catalogue/app/concierge inclusion, member eligibility verification, recurring communications.

### Elite House / resident management contour
Model: resident privilege, not key-handover flyer.
Proposed product: `RAIM SMILE Resident & Family Privilege`.
Why: value comes from access to already occupied communities and repeated resident contact.
Ask: resident app/chat/email/lobby/screens/events across existing projects.

### Bishkek International School / QSI
Model: parent/international-family support.
Proposed product: `RAIM SMILE International Family Support`.
Why: multilingual family need and repeated parent communication.
Ask: parent newsletter/events/education; no direct medical advertising to children.

## Priority B

### Optima Private Banking
Same model as BAKAI; compare access conditions and exclusivity.

### Hotels / premium concierge / expat channels
Product: `RAIM SMILE Guest Dental Concierge`.
Focus: multilingual navigation and urgent organizational routing, not treatment promises.

### Property managers / HOA-equivalent / serviced residential operators
Potentially stronger than developers after building handover because they retain resident contact.

## Infrastructure / paid distribution

### CityFrame
Role: indoor residential media/distribution partner rather than affinity partner.
Use case: trackable creative/QR tests by residential location and comparison with paid digital CAC.
A commercial-information request was initiated separately; do not treat as contracted/active until written terms are received and approved.

## Lower initial priority

- generic restaurants/cafes;
- ordinary retail without a defined premium/family audience;
- one-off flyer swaps;
- developers offering only a single key-handover insertion;
- partners unable to provide a measurable recurring audience touchpoint.

## Qualification score

Before outreach score each target 0–2 on:
1. audience fit;
2. repeated contact;
3. ability to verify eligibility;
4. distribution surfaces;
5. partner-side value from a dental privilege;
6. measurement/attribution;
7. conflict/exclusivity risk;
8. operational/legal simplicity.

Priority outreach requires a strong score on repeated contact and distribution; audience size alone is insufficient.
